items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And Eliska Pelleborn, one of my board members, her little granddaughter, was the first queen.

ctx.x: Oh, he never changes. The king before the queen.

So I said, why? Oh, it is always a rule that the king always precedes the queen. I said, but this is a ladies organization. Well, no matter. I said, well, yes, it does matter in this organization. Because on the beginning, we didn't have a queen. We called, my little granddaughter was the first mademoiselle fiesta. We called them mademoiselle fiesta. You see? We didn't have no queenship or anything. We called them mademoiselle. And I said, she was the first. And she was the first one to ride ahead of all the…
